note: Meets all five as cleanly as anyone in the batch. He owns multiple businesses now run by partners; income shows in behaviour rather than assertion — $260 per kettlebell without a second thought and no reaction at all to $6,000; and health is precisely the deferred area, in his own words: 'my work life has been very consuming up until recently... I justifiably prioritized work and family over getting to that next level.' Good-to-great is his own framing — 'getting to the next level of my health journey' from a base of consistent lifting at around 20% body fat toward 10%. He is not the excluded profile either: he trains regularly, just alone and at home. The pattern this call adds to the corpus is not about fit but about what fit conceals — a perfect-ICP prospect closed in 32 minutes without a single objection, which meant the process was never tested, and the one disqualifying signal present, sciatic symptoms on loaded lifting, is not something the stated ICP screens for.
